description: Colour encoding under OCIO (Painter's substance config) (recording plan R5, decision 100), on a project created as the wand's painter_create.py creates it (no template, OpenGL, 256 px, the 4x2 plane grid): BaseColor uniform (0.2, 0.5, 0.8) as sRGB (s0), with no colour space (s1), as Raw (s2); the authored 8-bit sRGB ramp as a UV bitmap (BilinearHQ, no repeat) set to sRGB (s3), Raw (s4), and sRGB inside a group masked by grey A (s5); s6 the wand's hammer-mark layer as the sync script sets it (BaseColor (75, 70, 65)/255 sRGB at opacity 0.25, SpecularRoughness 0.37, BaseMetalness 0.8, Height -0.003, Raw); s7 the same scalars with no colour space, Height 0.003 in LinearDodge. Captures: each bitmap's available and current colour spaces. BaseColor, SpecularRoughness, BaseMetalness, Height at PNG 16 and PNG 8, BaseColor at OpenEXR 32f, Normal_OpenGL at PNG 16; probes with $colorSpace in the file names.
